# netbox_notification_group (Data Source)

Reads a single NetBox notification group (`/api/extras/notification-groups/`) by `id` or filters.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Generated by internal/gen; edit generator/overrides to change, or remove this line to hand-maintain.
data "netbox_notification_group" "example" {
  id = 123
}

# Lookup by arbitrary API filters:
data "netbox_notification_group" "filtered" {
  filters = [
    { name = "id", value = "123" },
  ]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `filters` (Attributes List) Additional query filters as name/value pairs, e.g. `{ name = "tenant_id", value = "12" }`. Any query parameter of `/api/extras/notification-groups/` is accepted. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--filters))
- `id` (Number) The numeric ID of the object in NetBox.

### Read-Only

- `description` (String) Description. Defaults to the NetBox server default when omitted.
- `display` (String) Display.
- `display_url` (String) Display Url.
- `group_ids` (Set of Number) IDs of the assigned Group (`netbox_user_group`). Defaults to the NetBox server default when omitted.
- `name` (String) Name.
- `url` (String) Url.
- `user_ids` (Set of Number) IDs of the assigned User (`netbox_user`). Defaults to the NetBox server default when omitted.

<a id="nestedatt--filters"></a>
### Nested Schema for `filters`

Required:

- `name` (String) Query parameter name.
- `value` (String) Query parameter value.
